Use the supplied branch evidence and worktree paths. Inspect both worktrees: the left worktree must contain parallel-left.txt and not parallel-right.txt; the right worktree must contain parallel-right.txt and not parallel-left.txt. In this main workspace create tractor-fan-in-proof, copy those files to tractor-fan-in-proof/left.txt and tractor-fan-in-proof/right.txt, and verify from their started and finished values that the intervals overlap. Only after every check passes, write tractor-fan-in-proof/summary.txt with exactly two lines: isolation=verified and overlap=verified. Do not alter either branch worktree.

Notes: exit 0: left completed

Branch ID: right

---
name: agent-protocol
description: >
  Read at the start of every session and after context compaction to understand
  organization requirements and expected agent behavior.
---

1. Do task work in a worktree. Use the root checkout only for orientation and
   fast-forward synchronization.
2. For non-trivial tasks, maintain a worklog using `/session-worklog`. Record
   actionable intelligence, not routine activity.
3. Keep temporary operating material under `ephemeral/`. Never write to `docs/`
   without express permission.
4. Append to the worklog and make a checkpoint commit after each task. Do not
   rerun checks solely because of the commit. Complete the relevant proof and
   correctness protocol before declaring the PR merge-ready.
5. Squash-merge PRs. Write the PR body so it can serve as the squash commit
   message; put extended write-ups and review discussion in PR comments.
6. After merge, delete the task worktree and stop its background processes.
7. Fix broken tests or CI regardless of origin. If a pre-existing failure would
   materially distract from the task, ask HITL whether to proceed despite it.
8. Fast-forward the root checkout before starting work and after the PR merges.

`ephemeral/` is tracked working material such as worklogs, plans, and downloaded
artifacts. Create `ephemeral/projects/<project-slug>/` only when the user starts
or names a project, and follow any project list documented by the target repo.

args.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "for d in /tmp/r2-par/logs/worktrees-883991409/branch-001 /tmp/r2-par/logs/worktrees-883991409/branch-002; do
  printf '%s\\n' \""'$d"
  find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '"'parallel-*.txt' -print
  for f in \""'$d"/parallel-*.txt; do
    [ -e "$f" ] && { printf '"'%s:\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,20p' \""'$f"; }
  done
done'

args.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -eu
left=/tmp/r2-par/logs/worktrees-883991409/branch-001
right=/tmp/r2-par/logs/worktrees-883991409/branch-002
[ -f "$left/parallel-left.txt" ]
[ ! -e "$left/parallel-right.txt" ]
[ -f "$right/parallel-right.txt" ]
[ ! -e "$right/parallel-left.txt" ]
left_started=$(sed -n '"'s/"'^started=//p'"' \""'$left/parallel-left.txt")
left_finished=$(sed -n '"'s/"'^finished=//p'"' \""'$left/parallel-left.txt")
right_started=$(sed -n '"'s/"'^started=//p'"' \""'$right/parallel-right.txt")
right_finished=$(sed -n '"'s/"'^finished=//p'"' \""'$right/parallel-right.txt")
case "$left_started:$left_finished:$right_started:$right_finished" in (*[!0-9:]*|'"'') exit 1;; esac
[ \""'$left_started" -le "$left_finished" ]
[ "$right_started" -le "$right_finished" ]
[ "$left_started" -le "$right_finished" ]
[ "$right_started" -le "$left_finished" ]
shasum -a 256 "$left/parallel-left.txt" "$right/parallel-right.txt"
printf '"'validated left=[%s,%s] right=[%s,%s]\\n' \""'$left_started" "$left_finished" "$right_started" "$right_finished"
if [ -e tractor-fan-in-proof ]; then find tractor-fan-in-proof -maxdepth 2 -print; else printf '"'destination=absent\\n'; fi"

/bin/zsh -lc 'set -eu
left=/tmp/r2-par/logs/worktrees-883991409/branch-001
right=/tmp/r2-par/logs/worktrees-883991409/branch-002
cmp -s "$left/parallel-left.txt" tractor-fan-in-proof/left.txt
cmp -s "$right/parallel-right.txt" tractor-fan-in-proof/right.txt
[ -f "$left/parallel-left.txt" ] && [ ! -e "$left/parallel-right.txt" ]
[ -f "$right/parallel-right.txt" ] && [ ! -e "$right/parallel-left.txt" ]
[ "$(wc -l < tractor-fan-in-proof/summary.txt | tr -d '"' ')\" = 2 ]
printf 'isolation=verified\\noverlap=verified\\n' | cmp -s - tractor-fan-in-proof/summary.txt
shasum -a 256 \""'$left/parallel-left.txt" tractor-fan-in-proof/left.txt "$right/parallel-right.txt" tractor-fan-in-proof/right.txt
printf '"'%s\\n' 'summary:'
sed -n '1,3p' tractor-fan-in-proof/summary.txt"

text: {"notes":"Created `tractor-fan-in-proof` with exact copies as `left.txt` and `right.txt`. Verified worktree isolation, matching source/destination hashes, and overlapping intervals `[1786975854, 1786975858]`. `summary.txt` contains exactly the required two lines. Neither branch worktree was altered."}
